# RagRadar — Multi-Chain AI Intelligence API

> AI-powered on-chain analytics across Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon. 62 REST endpoints. Pay per call via x402 micropayments (USDC on Base or Solana).

## Base URL
https://ragradar.vercel.app

## Authentication
x402 micropayment protocol — pay USDC per request. No API keys needed. See /.well-known/x402 for discovery.

## Free Endpoints
- GET /health — Server status
- GET /api/protocols — List all endpoints
- GET /builder-code — ERC-8021 builder code
- GET /.well-known/x402 — x402 discovery

## Paid Endpoints (57 total)

### Wallet Analytics
- GET /api/portfolio/:chain/:address — Token balances ($0.005)
- GET /api/history/:chain/:address — Transaction history ($0.01)
- GET /api/summary/:chain/:address — Full wallet analytics ($0.02)
- GET /api/pnl/:chain/:address — Portfolio P&L breakdown ($0.05)
- GET /api/pnl/:chain/:address/summary — P&L summary ($0.02)
- GET /api/balance/:address — Multi-chain balance ($0.01)

### Token Safety
- GET /api/token-safety/:chain/:address — Rug risk, honeypot check ($0.02)
- GET /api/wallet-risk/:address — Wallet risk scoring ($0.03)
- GET /api/approvals/:chain/:address — Token approvals scan ($0.02)

### DeFi Yields
- GET /api/yields — All Base DeFi yields ($0.02)
- GET /api/yields/best/:asset — Best yield per asset ($0.01)
- GET /api/yields/risk — Yields by risk level ($0.02)
- GET /api/yields/rebalance — Rebalance recommendation ($0.05)

### Protocol Stats
- GET /api/protocols/base — Base protocol stats ($0.01)
- GET /api/protocols/base/tvl — TVL history ($0.01)
- GET /api/protocols/base/movers — Top movers 24h ($0.01)

### Sniper Tracker

- GET /api/sniper/wallet/:address — Sniper track record ($0.01)
- GET /api/sniper/trending — Top snipers on Base ($0.01)

### Smart Money

### NFT Analytics (NEW — Powered by Alchemy)
- GET /api/nft/portfolio/:address — NFT holdings per wallet ($0.50)

- GET /api/nft/floor/:chain/:contract — Floor price only ($0.20)
- GET /api/nft/sales/:chain/:contract — Recent NFT sales ($0.50)
- GET /api/nft/owners/:chain/:contract/:tokenId — NFT owners ($0.25)

## Tech
- Engine: Node.js + Express
- Payments: x402 protocol (Base + Solana)
- Data: DeFiLlama, DexScreener, GeckoTerminal, GoPlus, Etherscan, Blockscout, Alchemy NFT API
- Chains: Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, Celo
